author: Pony Boy
text_post: 1.  you aren't going to be confined to sarging ONLY in clubs.  there are girls everywhere.  so you can do this any day of the week. 2.  do whatever you want with your free time.  it's YOUR free time.  "the game" is not a way of life.  it is not a religion.  work on improving yourself as a person.  do you have any passions or hobbies you've been wanting to get into?  try that. 3.  there are different degrees of peacocking.  mystery is probably the most extreme case out there.  you can do something as simple as wearing cool sunglasses that get people's attention.  i have a white flat cap that somehow works as an article for peacocking.  do what works for you.  ...basically, just try to dress nice.  you're more likely to get women dressed nice than dressed horrible. ...before asking anymore questions...read through the forum.  you'll learn alot more, and probably earn alot more respect.
